Rashida M: hey team, Rashida here — excited to join CS today! quick list: HubSpot, Aircall, playbooks, objection cheat, scripts. who should i ping to get these asap? :wave:
Ben (IT): welcome Rashida! I can trigger HubSpot and Aircall invites. what email did you sign up with?
Rashida M: rashida@redwood.com
Ben (IT): thanks — invites sent for HubSpot and Aircall. HubSpot will ask you to set MFA. Aircall invite contains a one-time setup link. lmk if you don't see them in 10 min.
Olivia S: hey Rashida, i'm your CS buddy this week. i'll share the "First Week CS Cadence" and a quick Loom of our playbook flow. Check the playbooks drive under /playbooks/cs and the playbook named "cs_funnel_v3".
Onboarding Bot: Reminder: complete the "Sales/CS Security & Tools" checklist within 48h: https://onboard.redwood/checklists/sales-cs. Failure to complete may delay some access.
Rashida M: got HubSpot invite, set MFA. Aircall still pending. also can't find the objection cheat-sheet — searched for "objection" and found a lot. any exact filename?
Olivia S: file is "OBJECTION_MAP_v2 - CS" in /playbooks/cs/cheatsheets. i'll pin it and DM you the link. use the CS script template named `cs_templates_v1` in Notion for outbound call guides.
Ben (IT): resent Aircall invite. If the setup link errors, tell me your OS and browser.
Tiffany L: FYI recordings are on by default for training. if you prefer not to have your calls recorded until you're comfortable, DM compliance. welcome!! :tada:
Rashida M: aircall came through, headset configured. thanks everyone — excited to start listening to example calls. Rashida out for now :)
